text:
Lina B: heads-up — provisioning queue for ap-east-2 GPU nodes started failing around 07:12 UTC. nodes boot but fail early with disk crypto error, never join cluster.
Marcus V: got the same alert. Recent egress tighten went live at 02:00. suspect it's blocking keystore/TLS CA fetch or keystore-proxy chain.
Kai W: node-init logs show tls verify failures when hitting keystore-prx.corp.internal and also a 502 from the keystore-proxy endpoint. pasted snippet:```
Apr 29 07:13:10 cloud-init[1]: INFO fetching key https://keystore-prx.corp.internal/v1/decrypt
Apr 29 07:13:11 cloud-init[1]: ERR tls: certificate signed by unknown authority
Apr 29 07:13:12 init: ERROR cannot decrypt root volume, exiting
```
Elena R: only ap-east-2 was configured for host-based egress rules (SNI matching). We recently switched keystore hostnames from keystore.corp.internal -> keystore-prx.corp.internal CNAMEs to facilitate proxying for audit. Old hostlist in fw didn't include the new CNAME.
Lina B: options:
• revert egress to wide allow (fast, bad)
• add keystore-prx.corp.internal host rule with 1hr TTL (targeted)
• route keystore via ALB inside allowed CIDR (ops heavier)
Marcus V: FYI adding hostnames is low-risk if we limit to the warm-pool AZ and add TTL/auto-expire. But double-check cert chain: SNI rules match host; if proxy changes SNI or rotates certs, we could break again.
BillingBot: note: ALB adds ~$0.03/hr + data. Per-AZ NAT is ~$0.06/hr. Short TTL allowlist is cheapest.
Kai W: also saw audit-exporter OOM spikes on failed retries; if node-agent can't reach shipper, it keeps buffering and retries which consumes mem. For canary, lower buffer size to avoid OOM.
Lina B: proposed canary:
1) patch fw ap-east-2-warm-egress: add host keystore-prx.corp.internal (443) with ttl=1h and apt-mirror hosts 80/443
2) spin 6 canary nodes (tag: egress-canary=keystore-prx) in az-a only
3) reduce node-agent audit buffer to 8MB for canary
4) monitor kernel/init, kubelet register, and exporter backlog for 20m
Terraform snippet we will apply for host-based allow rule:```hcl
resource "fw_host_rule" "ap_e2_keystore_prx" {
  name = "ap-e2-keystore-prx-allow"
  vpc  = "vpc-aaaa"
  hosts = ["keystore-prx.corp.internal", "apt-mirror.corp.internal"]
  ports = [443, 80]
  ttl   = "1h"
}
```
Marcus V: I'll review cert chain before applying. If keystore-proxy cert chains to our internal CA, SNI mapping should be fine. If not, we need CA bundle update on init image.
Elena R: added check: resolve host via internal DNS to ensure IPs are private (no public NAT). Regulatory prohibits public egress for keystore traffic. Verified: CNAME resolves to eni IPs in the private subnet.
Kai W: canary started at 07:45 UTC. one node failed with the same decrypt error — posted last 5 init lines:```
Apr 29 07:46:11 cloud-init[1]: INFO fetching key https://keystore-prx.corp.internal/v1/decrypt
Apr 29 07:46:12 cloud-init[1]: ERR tls: unknown authority while using SNI: keystore-prx.corp.internal
Apr 29 07:46:13 init: ERROR cannot decrypt root volume
Apr 29 07:46:13 systemd[1]: cloud-init.service: main process exited, code=exited status=1
```
Lina B: Marcus, can you dump the server cert chain from the proxy and confirm it includes the internal CA?
Marcus V: grabbed cert chain from proxy at 07:47:22 — chain includes our internal CA but proxy rotates certs weekly; the init image's CA bundle is stale (missed last rollout). Looks like older nodes have older CA bundle.
Elena R: so fix path: update init image CA bundle + add host exception for immediate unblock.
Lina B: agree. plan: patch host rule for canary only, collect results. simultaneously, build new init image with updated CA bundle and stage to warmpool — that will resolve longer term.
OpsBot: Incident created INF-9310 "ap-east-2 gpu bootstrap decrypt errors after egress SNI tighten" assigned to @Lina B and @Marcus V. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9310 :warning:
Marcus V: applied host allow for az-a warm-pool (ttl=1h). canary reboots in progress.
Kai W: canaries rejoined at 07:58 UTC, audit exporter backlog drained in ~4 minutes. Node-agent memory stayed stable with reduced buffer. Marking canary success. :white_check_mark:
BillingBot: cost delta negligible for 1h host allow. ALB solution still more ops overhead; recommend CA bundle rollout + add preflight to fw pipeline to verify SNI/host mapping.
Elena R: filing PR to update init AMI CA bundle and adding an e2e preflight that resolves all hostnames and fetches cert chain before fw rollout.
Lina B: action items:
- Marcus: PR for CA bundle update and AMI bake (ETA tonight).
- Kai: add audit buffer override for canary workflows and add smoke test for bootstrap after fw changes.
- Elena: add host resolution/cert-check to fw pipeline.
I'll close thread once PR merged and canary validated in two regions. Thanks all.
